create_AltCLIPModel: create an AltCLIPModel instance with text and vision configs for multimodal image-text retrieval
run_AltCLIPModel_forward: run the AltCLIPModel forward pass with text and image inputs to compute contrastive logits
build_AltCLIPTextModel: build an AltCLIPTextModel from AltCLIPTextConfig to encode text into projected embeddings
build_AltCLIPVisionModel: build an AltCLIPVisionModel from AltCLIPVisionConfig to encode images into visual embeddings
test_AltCLIPModel_get_features: test AltCLIPModel get_text_features and get_image_features methods for embedding extraction
